description: This file defines configuration options, validation, and helper methods for Redis-based reminders in Orleans. It includes classes for setting Redis connection options, creating connection multiplexers, and validating configuration.

classes.name: RedisReminderTableOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration options for Redis reminders, including connection options, multiplexer creation delegate, and entry expiry.

classes.name: RedactRedisConfigurationOptions
classes.description: Custom attribute class for redacting Redis configuration details, especially passwords.

classes.name: RedisReminderTableOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates the RedisReminderTableOptions to ensure required configurations are set.

methods.name: DefaultCreateMultiplexer
methods.description: Default static method to create a Redis connection multiplexer asynchronously using provided configuration options.

methods.name: Redact
methods.description: Overrides the Redact method to hide sensitive information in ConfigurationOptions.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Checks if the ConfigurationOptions property is set; throws exception if not.
